about: Frozen split of the built-in examples for MODERNBERT_PARITY_PLAN.md, written before any training run of that plan. The goal is natural language in general (owner, 2026-11-05), so the examples are a check: they are reported and nothing is chosen on them. held_out: never trained on by any arm (the 4 test scenes of llm_bench/scenes_test are development data for sessions). training_scenes: their annotated rows (llm_train/scenes_r3, llm_train/scenes_r3b) are training data from arm M2s on, like any data; a score on them from then on is reported as fit on training data.
